items.t: Boeing Cuts 2,500 Jobs Because It Can’t Build Planes Fast Enough
items.sum: Boeing has a record $745 billion backlog and is still cutting about 2,500 airliner jobs, because its 737 factory can't reach 47 planes a month until 2027.

items.t: Brokers Suggest Investing in Boeing (BA): Read This Before Placing a Bet
items.sum: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), Boeing (BA) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

items.t: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Boeing (BA) on Nov. 11
items.sum: ETFs sold a net $25.2 million of Boeing stock on Nov. 11.

items.t: Boeing layoffs raise new fears about its financial future
items.sum: Investors are losing patience as the planemaker faces another setback.

items.t: $500 Invested in Boeing Today Could Be Worth This Much in 3 Years
items.sum: Achieving production and certification milestones by 2029 could drive a 46% share price increase in the aerospace and defense giant's stock price.

items.t: Boeing Stock Drops 25.6% in 3 Months: Should You Exercise Caution?
items.sum: BA faces production delays, labor shortages and 777X setbacks despite a record backlog and major defense wins.
